Name: Trash Remover
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]Remove all trash in your inventory[/b]

[b]List item will be removed :[/b]

[list]
[*]Broken CD
[*]Broken Glasses
[*]Driftwood
[*]Rotten Plant
[*]Soggy Newspaper
[*]Trash
[/list]
Default key to use is J , but you can change it on config.json

[b]How to Install :

[/b]1. Extract .zip file
2. Move Trash Remover folder to Stardew Valley/Mods

Manifest.Description: Remove all trash in your invetory with 1 click.
